sec.title: August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 314)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio, BBC Light Programme, and syndication, Carleton Hobbs & Norman Shelley recovering stolen naval submarine blueprints on *The New Adventures of Sherlock Holmes* (1964), Alexander Scourby in four spiritual and ethical dramatizations on NBC's *The Eternal Light* for the Jewish Theological Seminary (1949–1966), and a chilling loan shark thriller on *The Sounds of Darkness* (1949–1973):
